paragraphs: R' Yaakov, brother of Rav Acha bar Yaakov.
Mentioned in [Sanhedrin 76a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.76a.22-23), raising an objection to R' Ilaa’s statement.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rabbi Yaakov, brother of Rav Acha bar Yaakov, objecting to Rabbi Ilaa’s derivation. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2093&lang=en) cites the same daf.
Hyman abbreviates Yaakov’s and Ilaa’s titles in this notice; the linked Gemara writes Rabbi in full for both.
